purpose: Validate removal of the answer-map 10,000 target count guard with real SQLite data; retain CSV, field-definition, request-byte and print-byte guards.

conditions.backend: Release Rust/SQLx SQLite handlers, read-only immutable backup, actual map/map-filter/map-print/map-csv-check routes
conditions.frontend: Production-built real PC/mobile AnswerMapModal and real map/filter/color/print modules; instrumentation injected only by benchmark build
conditions.externalTilesIconsMedia: Blocked and replaced with local placeholders; no real authentication or external tile latency
conditions.memoryMetric: Chrome JS heap after forced GC; excludes full process memory and native DOM/graphics allocations
conditions.timingScope: Workflow includes API/database, HTTP/JSON, Vue, iframe render and settling plus automation coordination; not backend-only or full product timing
conditions.subsetFilteringCoverage: Synthetic PostgreSQL/SQLite integration tests filter 20,000 targets to the expected 10,000 target IDs; real filled condition matches all targets.

beforeDescription: Candidate with target-count guards already removed and original map-filter field expansion SQL from the Git base; shipped product could not open this >10,000-target scope. This is a single-run diagnostic comparison, not a before/after claim for cap removal.
afterDescription: Same candidate with identical-field-array representatives selected before map-filter field expansion, preserving map-filter target-type ascending tie order and existing schema/field limits.

verification.print: Actual full snapshot is structurally valid but exceeds 32MiB and is rejected; actual legend-masked 1,000-target snapshot generates all 1,000 shapes before print is allowed.
verification.printResourceWait: Bounded print geometry ready in 555.2ms; one layer stays loading/failed with placeholder resources and uses the existing 30s resource-timeout fallback. Object load status is neither loading nor failed. Do not interpret the ~30.8s print-button phase as geometry-rendering time.
verification.csv: Actual >10,000-answer map-csv-check request returns HTTP400 in both browser modes.
verification.closure: Both modes close/reopen three times; every closed cycle has zero iframes and zero retained renderer/runtime weak references.
verification.residualCost: Initial map still transfers/parses about 72.6MB of HTML; initial real workflow ~5.21s PC/~7.95s CPU4x mobile emulation. Whole-app or physical-device memory/performance is not guaranteed.

reproduction.shutdown: POST http://127.0.0.1:PORT/profile/shutdown (loopback only); then remove only the private database copy
